baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive أُوتِىَ, the possessed كِتَٰبَهُ, and the instrumental-spatial بِيَمِينِهِ make receipt, object, and bodily side jointly salient.
baseline_models.mechanism: A written object is granted into the recipient's right hand. The verse therefore stages judgment as an embodied transfer whose placement is part of the event, not merely as information about an unseen result.

activation_trace.role: Granting and bringing supplies the external handover that initiates the scene.
Letters joined into a written object supplies the materially legible item being handed over.
The right hand and right side locate the transfer in the recipient's body and grasp.

changed_reading.before: A person is simply told or shown the result of a record.
changed_reading.after: A person undergoes a public, bodily handover: the record arrives as something placed in the right-hand grasp.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كِتَٰبَهُ can name an established ruling or enrollment as well as a written sheet, while يَمِينِهِ can carry power and rightful force as well as anatomy.
baseline_models.mechanism: The granted book can function performatively: it fixes a judgment, registers the recipient's standing, and places that standing under a sign of recognized power or right. Receipt does not merely report status; it enacts it.

activation_trace.role: Granting makes the document an officially conferred instrument rather than a private note.
A binding inscription, decree, or judgment supplies the book's operative legal force.
Enrollment in a register or group supplies the social standing effected by the document.
Power, restraint, and the side of right make the hand a sign of authorized capacity.

changed_reading.before: The book passively describes an already settled fate.
changed_reading.after: The delivered book is an operative judgment that publicly installs its recipient in a recognized standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The joining branch of ك ت ب remains available inside كِتَٰبَهُ, and the possessive suffix makes the resulting aggregate specifically his.
baseline_models.mechanism: The book is not only prose written about the person; it is a dossier made by joining discrete items into one possessable whole. Delivery gathers plurality into a single object the recipient can hold.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies the dossier's aggregation of separate items.
Granting transfers the completed aggregate to the one whose book it is.
The literal hand turns an abstract aggregation into a bounded, graspable whole.

changed_reading.before: The book is imagined as a continuous narrative about the person.
changed_reading.after: The book is an assembled personal dossier whose many components have been joined into one graspable whole.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same يَمِين that denotes the right hand also carries oath and pledged bond, adjacent to كِتَٰب as binding inscription.
baseline_models.mechanism: The right hand may add a covenantal register to the bodily placement. A binding written determination is handed over under the latent sign of oath, making receipt resemble ratification as well as delivery.

activation_trace.role: Binding inscription supplies the durable determination that can be ratified.
The oath carried by the right hand supplies a latent pledge or ratification register.
Formal granting gives the binding instrument to its recipient.

changed_reading.before: Right hand names only the physical side on which the book appears.
changed_reading.after: Right hand may simultaneously mark bodily receipt and the pledged force of a binding instrument.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth's casting out and becoming empty supplies a material pattern of contents externalized; the human's arduous course toward an encounter supplies the personal process. Against that sequence, the assembled book can be read as the delivered yield of the person's course rather than as an unrelated document introduced at the end.

activation_trace.role: Produced yield latent in the giving root lets the handover carry the output of a prior process.
Joining separate things gives that output the form of one assembled dossier.
Casting something until it lies outside supplies the first motion of contents becoming exposed.
Emptiness after baring supplies the completed discharge of what had been held within.
Arduous work supplies the extended human process whose yield can be collected.
What a person encounters of good or harm makes the delivered dossier the encountered consequence of that course.

structural_cues: 84:4 moves from casting out what is within to being empty; 84:6 then moves from sustained toil to encounter immediately before 84:7.
The focus passive presents the book as arriving to the person, matching the preceding outward-transfer pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies discharge, toil, encounter, a joined book, and a yield branch; I infer that the sequence makes the book the externalized product of the human course. A live alternative is a pre-existing court record merely unveiled at the encounter.

changed_reading.before: The record is an external file with no visible causal relation to the life just completed.
changed_reading.after: The record is the person's dispersed course gathered and externalized as its delivered yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counting immediately follows receipt, and ease follows counting. This turns the assembled, binding book into the operative interface of reckoning: its ordered aggregation is what can be taken up and processed without obstruction.

activation_trace.role: Joined items supply an ordered dossier on which a reckoning can operate.
Binding judgment makes the dossier consequential rather than merely archival.
Counting and accounting identify the procedure for which the delivered book is usable.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies the unobstructed quality of that procedure.

structural_cues: The فَسَوْفَ consequence in 84:8 makes easy accounting the first explicit operation after the handover.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an assembled binding book followed by counting and ease; I infer that the document organizes and enables the reckoning. Alternatively, ease may be bestowed independently of how the book is composed.

changed_reading.before: The right-hand book is only a favorable token displayed before judgment.
changed_reading.after: The right-hand book is a ready-to-process dossier whose ordered contents participate in an unobstructed reckoning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate return to a group of belonging with inward joy activates the book's enrollment branch. The operative document can be carried as a credential of restored membership: judgment opens into social return, not only private relief.

activation_trace.role: Enrollment in a register or group lets the book establish recognized membership.
Rightful force supplies the standing by which the recipient can return openly.
Return and destination supply the movement that the newly established standing permits.
A group defined by proximity and belonging supplies the social destination of the return.
Inward joy and ease supply the affective confirmation that belonging has been restored.

structural_cues: 84:9 makes movement toward one's people, not an isolated emotional state, the endpoint of the right-hand sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enrollment, rightful standing, return, belonging, and joy; I infer that the book functions like a credential enabling social reintegration. The alternative is that it only certifies a judgment whose later social result is causally separate.

changed_reading.before: Receipt secures an individual acquittal with no social mechanism.
changed_reading.after: Receipt establishes a portable standing through which the person returns joyfully into a community of belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adverse parallel preserves the same giving and book but relocates it behind the back. The decisive contrast is therefore not the document's existence but the recipient's embodied orientation to it: held on the capable, visible side versus displaced into concealment and turned-away posture.

activation_trace.role: The right hand supplies visible grasp and bodily availability in the favorable scene.
Power and rightful force turn that visible grasp into a posture of acknowledged agency.
Putting something behind appearances supplies concealment and displacement in the adverse scene.
The back as opposite the belly supplies the concrete bodily reversal of open, forward grasp.
Turning backs to one another supplies the relational stance of disowning what is delivered.

structural_cues: 84:10 repeats the passive handover and possessed book from 84:7, changing the receiving location to behind the back.
The parallel contrasts right hand with back rather than explicitly contrasting right with left.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact handover parallel with opposed bodily placements; I infer that placement dramatizes owning and facing the record versus displacing and disowning it. A live alternative treats both placements as assigned signs with no recipient agency implied.

changed_reading.before: Right hand is a conventional positive label whose physical posture adds little.
changed_reading.after: Right-hand receipt depicts a capable, open relation to one's record, sharply opposed to receiving it in a concealed, turned-away orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later oath root combines division into portions with a sworn right hand. It activates the latent covenantal branch in يَمِينِهِ and makes the binding book resemble a ratified allotment: a determined portion or standing formally assigned to its holder.

activation_trace.role: Binding determination supplies the fixed ruling embodied in the book.
The sworn right hand supplies a covenantal force alongside literal bodily placement.
Separating and assigning a portion supplies the allotment enacted by the determination.
An oath distributed among its parties bridges sworn force and assigned share.

structural_cues: The explicit oath in 84:16 follows the two contrasted book-receipt sequences and precedes the account of successive states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a binding book, an oath-bearing right hand, and a later root joining oath with division; I infer that receipt can be heard as ratified allotment. Alternatively, the later oath may attest the surah's claims without altering the hand's function in 84:7.

changed_reading.before: The right hand only indicates where a favorable document is placed.
changed_reading.after: The right hand also lends sworn authorization to a binding share or standing assigned by the document.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night gathers what is dispersed, then the moon reaches complete coherence. This two-step image activates the joining branch of كِتَٰب: the book is a totalization process in which scattered particulars are collected and brought into a finished, reviewable whole.

activation_trace.role: Joining separate items supplies the book's underlying operation of collection.
Gathering dispersed things supplies the movement from scattered particulars toward one dossier.
Completion and even coherence supply the finished wholeness of the gathered record.

structural_cues: The paired oath images progress from night gathering contents in 84:17 to the moon becoming complete in 84:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collection, completion, and the focus book's joining branch; I infer that the cosmic progression models how the dossier becomes whole. The alternative is that these images establish change and regularity without modeling the book's composition.

changed_reading.before: The book is a miscellaneous list already lying complete.
changed_reading.after: The book is the completed whole produced by gathering dispersed particulars into coherent reviewable form.

context_deltas.mechanism: Superposition and passage from state to state give the gathered book internal depth. Its joined items can be read as successive layers of a life, while receiving the completed stack is itself the threshold into another state.

activation_trace.role: Joined components anchor the proposed layered structure inside the focus book.
One thing superposed on another supplies vertical accumulation within the dossier.
Layers placed one above another supply the record's stratified organization.
State after state supplies the temporal succession represented by those layers.

structural_cues: The doubled طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ construction makes succession and stratification explicit immediately after gathering and completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies superposition, layers, successive states, and an assembled focus book; I infer that the book can stratify a life and that its receipt marks a further transition. Alternatively, 84:19 may describe only the audience's transformations, not the record's architecture.

changed_reading.before: The record flattens a life into an undifferentiated total.
changed_reading.after: The record preserves successive conditions as joined layers, and its handover ushers the recipient into the next condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reading makes gathered signs public, covering resists disclosure, and inward containment stores meaning before divine knowledge. Together they recast the book as an exteriorized counter-container: what the person held and covered within is joined into a legible object returned to that person's own hand.

activation_trace.role: Joined letters and the written object supply the public legibility of the exterior record.
Joining separate contents supplies the compilation that converts inward plurality into one book.
Reading and recitation supply the conversion of gathered signs into publicly apprehensible discourse.
Covering supplies the contrary movement by which contents or truth are kept from view.
Disclosure to the knower supplies access that defeats concealment.
Holding meaning within the heart supplies the interior archive from which the record may be externalized.
Enclosing a thing in a vessel supplies the container analogy answered by the bounded book.

structural_cues: 84:21-23 moves from material being read to refusal, covering-denial, divine knowing, and what is inwardly amassed.
The possessive in كِتَٰبَهُ returns the now legible aggregate to the same person whose contents it bears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reading, covering, knowing, inward containment, and the focus's written joined object; I infer an arrow from concealed interior accumulation to exterior legible dossier. A live alternative keeps divine knowledge, inward storage, and the handed book as related but separate facts.

changed_reading.before: The book is evidence compiled elsewhere and alien to the recipient's interior life.
changed_reading.after: The book is the public, legible form of what had been inwardly accumulated or covered, returned as the recipient's own record.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the narrow manumission-contract branch of ك ت ب. It remains anchored in كِتَٰبَهُ and is reinforced by the later labor, wage, and non-cutoff chain; downstream prose should present it only as a contract-of-release analogy, not as a claim that the ayah lexically denotes manumission.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كِتَٰبَهُ carries a branch in which a written performance contract culminates in release, while the right-hand power branch can mark restored capacity.

activation_trace.role: A performance contract culminating in emancipation supplies the release-instrument analogy.
Power and rightful capacity supply the condition into which the document releases its holder.
A worker's wage supplies the performed-labor side of the release analogy.
Compensation for work supplies the payable outcome of completed performance.
Cutting or diminishing an extension, negated in the source construction, supplies compensation not terminated by cutoff.

changed_reading.before: The book is only a verdict sheet issued after labor has ended.
changed_reading.after: The book can be carried, analogically, as a completed performance instrument that releases the worker into uncut compensation and restored capacity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the left-hand image belongs to a branch of ي س ر while the surface in 84:8 means easy, and the adverse parallel explicitly says behind the back rather than left hand. It remains anchored by the immediate right-hand-to-easy sequence and the bodily mirror; downstream prose should call it a latent lateral echo, never a translation of يَسِيرًا as left-handed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The explicit right hand in 84:7 is immediately followed by a form from a root whose inventory also contains the left hand, while 84:10 relocates the adverse book behind the body.

activation_trace.role: The literal right hand establishes the first side of the latent lateral field.
The left hand and left side create a branch-level echo inside the word describing the ensuing ease.
Concealment behind appearances redirects the adverse contrast away from a simple left-hand binary.
The literal back supplies the actual opposed bodily location used by the parallel.

changed_reading.before: Right hand is a fixed moral badge opposed to an assumed but unstated left hand.
changed_reading.after: The immediate ease-word carries a faint left-side echo while the adverse scene moves behind the body, making right-hand receipt more about open capable orientation than a simple right-versus-left code.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links branch-distant cosmic, somatic, and material images of splitting, joining edges, and bone healing. It remains anchored in the primary joining branch of ك ت ب and the surah's repeated split-to-gather movement; downstream prose should render it as a reassembly analogy, not as a claim that the book literally heals the cosmos or body.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The joining operation latent in كِتَٰبَهُ can answer the packet's opening rupture with a bounded object in which separated particulars are reconnected.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another anchors reassembly in the focus word itself.
Splitting open supplies the initial rupture whose separated contents require a new relation.
Thickening an edge and joining two halves supplies a material seam between rupture and compilation.
Bone knitting after fracture supplies the strongest branch-distant image of parts regaining coherence.

changed_reading.before: The book only freezes a finished identity into evidence.
changed_reading.after: The book can also be imagined as a bounded reassembly of what rupture and passage had dispersed, making a life coherent enough to be faced and held.

strongest_changes: The book shifted from an external file to the gathered, externalized yield of the person's arduous course.
The immediate easy reckoning made the assembled book an operative accounting interface rather than a mere verdict token.
The behind-the-back parallel made right-hand placement a posture of open capability and ownership, not only a favorable side label.
The gathering, completion, and inward-containment cues made the book a coherent public form of dispersed and concealed contents.
Return to one's people activated the book as a credential of restored belonging alongside its judicial function.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several coexisting mechanisms without requiring a final choice: bodily handover, operative judgment, assembled dossier, sworn allotment, social credential, and exteriorized interior archive. The packet's strongest latent movement was from dispersion or concealment toward a record that can be held, read, reckoned, and faced; branch-distant contract, lateral, and repair images remained live under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not decide whether right-hand placement causes favorable standing, displays it, or is simply assigned as its sign.
The causal arrows from toil or inward storage to compilation into the book are abductive; the record could instead pre-exist and merely be disclosed.
The oath, manumission-contract, left-side, and repair activations are branch-valid but form-distant and should not displace the concrete handover baseline.
The gathered-whole and layered-record models may describe the book's architecture, the person's transitions, or both by analogy.
